knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A dirty duster moves dust onto the next surface, so cleaning after each route prevents spreading.
Damp fibres can develop odour in storage. Drying first prevents this.
Zone rules keep washroom cloths away from desks. A crossover is recorded and the cloth is taken out of use for that zone.

practicalCriteria: Washes dusters and cloths at the label dose, rinses, squeezes and hangs them to dry.
Cleans a static duster by submerging the head and spinning off the water, then hangs it by the handle.
Keeps zone baskets separate and records any cross-zone use.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% pass mark, which for three questions means all three correct. Practical sign-off is separate and observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of one wash and dry cycle
Cloth-change record, where the site requires one
stopWorkCriteria: Restroom cloth used on a desk or touch point
